guidanceConsulted.query: embedding cross-origin iframe lazy loading accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Place all content in semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <footer>), use sequential headings, semantic tables with <caption> and <th scope>, explicit :focus-visible outlines, and aria-labelledby over duplicated aria-label.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, sequential h1/h2/h3, captioned tables with <th scope='col|row'>, focusable .table-wrap scroll regions wired via aria-labelledby to table captions with a 3px :focus-visible outline, and role='note' on the Baseline banner.

guidanceConsulted.query: long code blocks typography readable narrow mobile screens
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Apply text-wrap: balance specifically to short multi-line headings (h1-h3) and avoid applying it globally; keep body/code typography legible on narrow screens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: h1, h2, h3 use text-wrap: balance (progressive enhancement with graceful wrap fallback); h1, .lede, and inline code use overflow-wrap: anywhere; pre blocks scroll horizontally with overflow-x: auto. Exception: text-wrap: pretty omitted on body paragraphs to avoid unnecessary line-breaking work across long reference prose.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table on mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing properties (max-inline-size), flex-wrap: wrap with gap for wrapping lists, overflow: auto for scroll containers, and never mask layout overflow with overflow: hidden.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap uses max-inline-size: 100% with horizontal scrolling for wide tables, .baseline-browsers uses display: flex with flex-wrap: wrap and gap, and pre uses overflow-x: auto without overflow: hidden clipping.

guidanceConsulted.query: technical documentation typography readability inline code headings tables
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic light-dark() tokens with prefers-color-scheme fallback, clear heading hierarchy, soft subtle borders on inline code/tables, and accessible contrast across light and dark modes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: added On-this-page .local-nav jump bar, placed .lede before .baseline-banner, removed redundant inline pre/table overrides in favor of shared public/styles.css semantic tokens, and visually verified desktop light/dark and 360px mobile screenshots (0px overflow).
